description: Four units of a stereo core frame and an extension substream with a lossless 5.1 asset that has a dynamic range code and an embedded stereo downmix, of which only the first states the static fields.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.decode_alone: ffmpeg keeps the static fields between frames (dca_exss.c), so a unit whose header omits them decodes only after the first: each packet decoded alone is rejected ('Read past end of EXSS asset descriptor'), the whole file decodes without an error
